annotations.text: THE SACRED SNAKE.

This snake a Python, was photographed at a village near, Manila, Philippine Islands, it is 14 feet long, albino pure Manila, Philippine Islands, it is 14 feet long, albino pure white with beautiful golden spots, and red eyes. The girl who was born at the same time as the snake, is 14 years old, and they have grown up together. The natives attribute healing powers to the snake and come from afar off places to worship it. Consequently its guardian, the girl is locked upon as a sacred person.

A CHANGE FOR THE BETTER: THE LION A GOOD SUBSTITUTE FOR THE SAGLE. The British military District Officer explaining that a change of sovereignty has taken place to the native chiefs at Norobe, New Guinea. It will be noticed that some of the chiefs are wearing German officers helmets.

A WOMAN'S DARING: In the centre of this group of miners and natives is Mrs Doris Booth, the prospector's frail wife who struggled across the mountains, through swamps and past cannibal settlements for five weeks to the New Guinea goldfields. She helped to work her husband's claim and at the same time nursed 105 sick miners. The Booth claim is now or offer for $40,000.

PAPIAN CAPITALS. These Papian natives included among whom are two women were blown five hundred miles out of their course in a frail cause when navigating off the coast of Papua recently. They were picked up in the Solomones after being tossed about on the waters of the Pacific for a month with practically no food or water and have now been shipped back to their native land.

SOLMONE MASSES: Group of friendly beach natives at Melaita where men from H.M.A.S.Adelade have established a base camp for the punitive expedition against the murders of white men recently. The leader of the murders is a former police boy from Rabaul the capital of New Guinea. He is doubly treacherous and dangerous since he has mixed with whites and knows their ways while he still retains all the running and treachery of the native.

SOLMONS MASSAGES: The graves of the white men murdered by rebellious natives at Malta. The murderers have fled into the dense tropical jungle with theirReportions, deserting the villages and the punitive expedition is finding the greatest difficulty in following them along precipitous tracks.
PICTURESQUE CHARM OF THE FIJI ISLANDS, 20427.

The picturesque charm of the Fiji Islands, is seen in frequently described in works of fiction, is seen in reality in this picture. Despite the inroads of civilisation, much remains of the quaint beauty of native dress and costumes.
Photo shows. An original version of pick-a-back riding, which is very popular with the young Fijians.
JOURNALISME AUX ANTUPODES

Dans les Iles Fiji - ou les journalsaux n'existent pas - il ya tout de meme un "corp de journalistes" qui se charge de propager d'un bout a l'autre du pays les dernières nouvelles, leshistores de guerre, les announces de mariggses et de mort, etc. Ce "corp" est constitués par des danseurs appeles "Mikki" quidont de village en village en dansant et en chantant en meme temps les nouvelles. Il y a des "mikkis" ( ou "redacteurs")omednes et fennes et ils se reunissent a une "Maison de Presse" qui porte le nom de "Moure - ni - sa" d'ou les nouvelles se propagent dans les iles.

Nos photos caractéristiques montrent des scène de ce curieux journalism par le que le monde ignore.
